integrity.method: exact geometric argument plus standalone arithmetic checks

scientific_limitations: Only the displayed integral model over the complete local base at five is covered.
No priority claim is made for the generic 27 lines, the special singular point, or the general theory of nodal cubic surfaces.
Geometric completeness uses a projection argument; the finite-field enumeration is only a check.
Independent scientific audit and specialist historical-priority review have not been performed.
title: The ramified \(27\)-line scheme of the Clebsch cubic at \(5\)
